edges.reason: Crafting a crafting_table requires 4 planks, which are crafted from the spruce_log obtained by mining the spruce tree
Mining spruce_log first teaches the player mining mechanics and orients them in the scene before locating the slabs
Mining the slab confirms the pickaxe works; renaming it at the anvil is the final task requiring XP from experience bottles

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a spruce_log drops it into the player's inventory. The player does not start with any spruce_log, so min_count=1 cleanly detects task completion. Spruce logs are at spawn-relative (+3, 0-3, +2).

Uses inventory_has because crafting a crafting_table (spruce_log → 4 planks → crafting_table in 2x2 grid) places the item in inventory. Player does not start with a crafting_table, so min_count=1 cleanly detects completion.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_andesite_slab with a pickaxe drops the slab item into inventory. Player does not start with any polished_andesite_slab. Slabs are at spawn-relative (+10-11, 0, +2-3).

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind='block' and object='anvil' to detect that the anvil at spawn-relative (+7, +1, +3) has been used and degraded. Anvils have a 12% chance per use to degrade from 'anvil' to 'chipped_anvil'. While not 100% reliable on a single use, this is the only available rule type that can detect anvil interaction. The generous box (±3) around the anvil position ensures detection regardless of exact placement. This is chosen because inventory_has for iron_pickaxe is pre-satisfied (player starts with one), and no rule type exists to check item NBT/custom names or use_item counters directly.

scene_description: A cleared stone brick platform (24x24 blocks) with: (1) A small spruce tree (4 logs + leaves) for mining wood, (2) An anvil on a polished andesite pedestal for renaming the pickaxe, (3) A 2x2 patch of polished andesite slabs for mining. The player starts with an iron pickaxe and 64 experience bottles. The platform is cleared of all natural vegetation to make objectives clearly visible.
task_text: Complete the following tasks in order: 1) Mine a spruce log from the tree on the platform. 2) Craft a crafting table from the wood. 3) Mine a polished andesite slab using your pickaxe. 4) Use the experience bottles to gain XP, then rename your pickaxe at the anvil.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin on stone brick floor. Spruce tree at (+3, 0-4, +2) with leaves crown. Anvil at (+7, +1, +3) on polished andesite pedestal at (+7, 0, +3). Polished andesite slabs in 2x2 patch at (+10-11, 0, +2-3). All within 12 blocks of spawn. The anvil is at a fixed known coordinate for milestone detection - when used, anvils can degrade from 'anvil' to 'chipped_anvil'. Player inventory: iron_pickaxe (1) + experience_bottle (64).
